extract.description: An unidentified person deliberately scratched the parked vehicle doors.

followup.question: On what date did this happen? Were the police informed, and were there any witnesses?

compose.answer: In claim_types_policy.pdf, page 4, the fictional wording supports possible cover for this event [P.4]. An eligible own-vehicle claim has a EUR 300 deductible on page 6 [P.6]. A claims handler must check the documents before deciding the case.
next_steps: A human claims handler reviews the case.
